notes: 2018_00_link.txt is the Academic Affairs Faculty Handbook, revised 2016-11-22; 2018_01_cba_2015_2018.txt is the BOT/UFF agreement 2015-2018, ratified 2016-06-07, term to 2018-06-30.

Governing documents: the 2015-2018 collective bargaining agreement (in force on 2018-02-22) and the 2016 faculty handbook; the procedures and request form implement Art. 17.9 (17.9(d) requires the signed agreement); the provost page restates eligibility. The handbook's 'Other policies' list still names the 2012-2015 agreement; its Parental Leave section points to 'the most recently-ratified version' (the saved 2015-2018 agreement).

Population: tenure-stream faculty are 9-month (39-week academic-year) members of the UFF bargaining unit and do not accrue annual leave, so Art. 17.9 paid parental leave applies to them; 10- and 12-month appointees are excluded from it.

Paths (U8): the member described is eligible for paid parental leave and FMLA. The paid semester (c1) and the unpaid six-month leave (c2, with up to 6 weeks of own sick leave c3, then optional part-time leave without pay c11) are alternatives (17.8(a): 'ineligible or chooses not to utilize'), linked in_lieu_of. For those ineligible for paid leave, the sick-leave allowance rises to 8 weeks (in c3's duration_note).

Chain, birth parent: paid parental leave 1 semester, FMLA 12 workweeks concurrent from its start; or, instead, unpaid parental leave up to 6 months (own sick leave up to 6 weeks within it from the birth; FMLA concurrent) -> part-time leave without pay up to 1 year. Own illness: documented medical absence (c5), STD/LTD (c7, c8), sick leave pool after own leave (c9) are not linked to the parental chain.

Chain, non-birth parent: paid parental leave 1 semester with FMLA concurrent; or unpaid parental leave up to 6 months (own sick leave up to 6 weeks within it; FMLA concurrent) -> part-time leave without pay up to 1 year.
Pay level of the paid parental leave: the agreement says 'paid parental leave' and requires repayment of 'all salary received'; no percentage is stated. pay_fraction records it as written.

The agreement defines 'semester' as one of two approximately 19.5-week periods of the 39-week academic year. That is a pay or appointment period, not a term length (R8, which names this agreement): calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Tenure clock: Art. 17.5 excludes any leave semester from tenure credit unless both parties agree (c12, general purpose); the PPL procedures and signed form instead stop the clock only on request (c14, flagged conflicting_sources); 15.1(b)(3) allows a discretionary stop of up to two years for medical or related reasons (c13).

Not components: compulsory leave (17.10(c); imposed by the Provost when an employee cannot work, not a leave a parent requests; up to one year, paid from accrued leave or unpaid); sabbatical and study leave (professional development); union leave and released time; military, jury, holiday and investigation leave; job-related illness (workers' compensation).

Cited but not saved: STD and LTD plan provisions (17.8(c)3); University FMLA policies (17.7); sick leave pool rules (pool named in 17.10(a)(2), terms only in the handbook); University policy on jury, military and other administrative leaves (17.12); Provost memoranda (handbook); University Regulations (handbook); 2012-2015 agreement (handbook list; superseded).

Statutory baseline: FMLA (US) -> c4, verified against statute texts 2026_00 and 2026_01; Federal Employee Paid Leave Act not applicable. Florida has no rows in the baseline table and the documents name no Florida leave statute.

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
